Definition: to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate
BiblicalUsage: The word tᵉqêph carries the sense of to become mighty. In Daniel 4:11, The tree grew, and was strong, and it appears again in Daniel 4:20.
TheologicalSignificance: A tree that grew strong until it touched heaven shows me how quickly greatness can turn into pride.
